name: selectpanel
need: Pick several values in a popover with a filter and an apply foot: labels, assignees, filters

--ds-selectpanel-width.description: the select panel's width (at most the viewport's less 16px)

--ds-selectpanel-list-max-height.description: the select panel's list before it scrolls inside the panel

--ds-selectpanel-radius.description: the corners of the select panel, times `--ds-shape`

labExempt.DS.selectpanel.create: the controller; the panel's motion is DS.selectpanel.open and close
